messages.subject: Reminder of St. Andrews Distance sampling workshops August 2014
messages.subject_clean: Reminder of St. Andrews Distance sampling workshops August 2014
messages.body_plain:
Distance workshops are beginning to fill.  Early registration deadline
is mid-July.

Introductory workshop 19-22 August
Advanced workshop 25-28 August

Please visit the website
http://creem2.st-andrews.ac.uk/workshops/distance-sampling-workshops-st-andrews-august-2014/

for more details.

--
Eric Rexstad
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Centre for Research into Ecological and Environmental Modelling
University of St. Andrews
St. Andrews Scotland KY16 9LZ
+44 (0)1334 461833
